title: MSFS Marketplace Update: New Carenado Do 228, He 70 Blitz & 30-Aircraft Megapacks!
description:
Are you looking to expand your virtual hangar in Microsoft Flight Simulator this week, or are you trying to avoid impulse buys on the storefront? Today, we break down the latest marketplace drop featuring new standalone airframes alongside Microsoft's massive fleet bundle collections.

To help you decide what fits your flight routine and budget, we inspect each arrival in detail:

• Carenado Dornier Do 228: High-wing twin-turboprop STOL performance, realistic Garrett TPE331 handling, 13 included liveries (featuring the Dutch Coast Guard), and tablet-swappable GNS/GTN avionics.
• Microsoft / iniBuilds Heinkel He 70 Blitz: The Gamescom release bringing 1930s aerodynamic innovation, high-speed regional history, and a vintage BMW piston engine to life.
• MSK Saab MFI-17 Safari: Swedish lightweight STOL trainer equipped with Garmin avionics, ideal for low-and-slow VFR exploring across recent City Updates.
• Microsoft Megapacks & Bundles: A complete overview of the 30-aircraft Aviator Pack versus targeted 10-aircraft selections in Famous Flyers Pack 1 and Local Legends Packs 1 & 2 (including the An-225, B707, ATR, DHC-4, and more).

Whether you're after rugged island hopping, vintage aviation cruising, or an instant fleet expansion in one single purchase, we evaluate each package to help you decide what truly deserves a spot in your virtual hangar.

If you enjoy honest, clear, and critical looks at the Flight Simulator Marketplace without the fluff, make sure to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel, and drop a comment below! Which of these aircraft or bundles are you adding to your hangar?
